autonomy_levels._source: The Agentic State vision paper (agenticstate.org/paper.html), autonomy ladder L0-L5

status._source: Anchored to EU JRC AI Watch 'AI in public services' lifecycle, extended for observatory use
status.announced: Publicly announced, no build evidence yet
status.scaled: Expanded beyond initial scope (agencies, regions, volume)
status.unclear: Cannot be determined from the source

types._source: Observatory enum after a 2026-07 review of OECD/EC/World Bank schemes (none spans policy and deployments in one field). Each value anchors to an established vocabulary: deployment = EC Public Sector Tech Watch use-case scope (JRC137409); strategy incl. governance bodies = OECD.AI policy instruments 'National strategies, agendas and plans' / 'Creation or reform of governance structure or public body'; regulation = OECD.AI 'Emerging AI-related regulation' (laws, guidance, standards, sandboxes); procurement = GovLab AI Localism and Stanford AI Index procurement tracking
types._rules: Classify the FORM the news takes, not the domain it serves. One primary type, optional second when a record genuinely straddles (max 2, primary first). Nameable system at any stage, even future = deployment (status carries timing); the buying itself = procurement; rules and rule-making incl. consultations = regulation; plans, funding, training and new bodies = strategy; a body that enforces rules = strategy first, regulation second.
types.deployment: A nameable AI system in government hands, at any lifecycle stage
types.strategy: Stated intentions and capacity building: plans, funding programmes, training, governance bodies
types.regulation: Rules and rule-making: laws, bills, executive orders, guidance, standards, consultations
types.procurement: The buying itself: tenders, RFPs, sources-sought notices, contract awards
